item.title: Off-road bikes are going back to the future, and I’m here for it
item.description: Michael might not be buying into all of the latest trends, so it's a good job that some older tech is making a comeback. Just with newer names...

item.title: Amsterdam mulls over 'fat bike' ban — but will tyre width restriction really help protect city's famous bike lanes from threat of illegally modified e-bikes?
item.description: The Dutch cycling utopia is under threat from modified e-bikes. Is a ban based on tyre width really the best compromise? It's a little complicated, as we've been finding out

item.title: Councillor raising funds for legal battle against congestion charge… by cycling
item.description: Councillor David Henwood - who was found to have harassed a Labour councillor in online spats over traffic measures in Oxford - plans to cycle every day until Christmas to raise money for Open Roads in a legal challenge against Oxfordshire Council

item.title: Garmin's latest power meter pedals, a £325 front light from Exposure + more cool things from Rapha, Oquo and Magicshine
item.description: This week’s line-up includes a £325 smart front light, updated Rapha winter tights, pro-level Oquo wheels and Magicshine’s photochromic glasses

item.title: Portland Design Works Full Metal Fenders 700x55mm
item.description: Very strong, stable mudguards with a sleek, refined look 9/10

item.title: “Entitled” driver moans about “extremely irritating” children cycling to school “chatting” and taking up “whole road”; Endura launches ‘Don’t be a helmet. Wear one’ campaign… with fake crash; NSN’s Barca kit; Mini G; Hideous Ineos? + more on the live blog
item.description: Still drying off from your stormy morning commute? Don’t worry, Ryan Mallon’s here to brighten up your day (kind of) with all the latest cycling news, views, and silliness on the wet and windy Tuesday live blog

item.title: British Cycling brings in corporate finance consultants and creates new events wing to "supercharge commercial growth" amid declining membership figures
item.description: British Cycling says separating their commercial businesses into a new entity can "grow events and new digital revenue streams"

item.title: Seven people arrested after counterfeit Specialized manufacturers busted in Chinese police raid
item.description: Chinese tech giant Alibaba say the seizure of fraudulent goods was the largest anti-counterfeit measure in Specialized's history

item.title: Specialized Tarmac SL8 Comp
item.description: A good race bike that is begging for a few upgrades 7/10

item.description: Cycling Brands Ltd, which also owns custom-clothing maker Shutt Velo Rapide, said they "are not complacent" despite the upturn in fortunes.
